steps.name: basics
steps.label: Basics
steps.description: Build a Linux golden image with the CrowdStrike Falcon sensor pre-installed. Provide your Falcon API Client ID/Secret. A Key Vault is created and seeded with the secrets by the deployment. The sensor is installed with PREP_GOLDEN_IMAGE so the AID is stripped for cloning.

location.label: Region
location.toolTip: Region for the gallery, image, Key Vault, and Image Builder template.

elements.name: falconClientId
elements.label: CrowdStrike API Client ID
elements.toolTip: Falcon OAuth2 API client id. Needs Sensor Download (read) and Sensor Update Policies (read) scopes.

validations.message: Client ID is a 32-character hexadecimal string.

elements.name: falconClientSecret
elements.toolTip: Falcon OAuth2 API client secret. Stored as a secret in the Key Vault created by this deployment.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter the API client secret (letters and numbers, 32+ characters).

elements.name: sensorUpdatePolicyName
elements.label: Sensor Update Policy name (optional)
elements.toolTip: Optional Linux Sensor Update Policy that determines which sensor version to install. Leave empty to install the latest available version. If you set a policy, it must resolve to a version currently available in the download catalog.

validations.message: Enter a sensor update policy name (or leave empty).

options.text: Select the base Linux image via the dropdowns (pulled live from Azure). The golden image is Gen2 / Trusted Launch and x64, so ARM64 and -gen1 SKUs are hidden — choose a Gen2-capable SKU (e.g. one ending in -gen2, or Ubuntu 24.04's 'server'). Defaults target Ubuntu Server 22.04 LTS (Gen2).

elements.name: sourceImagePublisher
elements.label: Publisher
elements.toolTip: Marketplace image publisher (pulled live from Azure, filtered to common Linux publishers). Type to search.

constraints.allowedValues: [map(filter(steps('sourceImage').publishersApi, (item) => or(contains(item.name, 'Canonical'), or(contains(item.name, 'RedHat'), or(contains(item.name, 'SUSE'), or(contains(item.name, 'OpenLogic'), or(contains(item.name, 'credativ'), contains(item.name, 'Debian'))))))), (item) => parse(concat('{"label":"', item.name, '","value":"', item.name, '"}')))]

elements.name: sourceImageOffer
elements.label: Offer
elements.toolTip: Marketplace image offer for the selected publisher (pulled live from Azure).

elements.name: sourceImageSku
elements.label: SKU
elements.defaultValue: [coalesce(first(map(filter(steps('sourceImage').skusApi, (item) => and(contains(item.name, 'gen2'), and(not(contains(toLower(item.name), 'arm')), not(contains(toLower(item.name), 'cvm'))))), (item) => item.name)), first(map(filter(steps('sourceImage').skusApi, (item) => and(not(contains(toLower(item.name), 'gen1')), and(not(contains(toLower(item.name), 'arm')), not(contains(toLower(item.name), 'cvm'))))), (item) => item.name)))]
elements.toolTip: Linux SKU for the selected offer (pulled live from Azure). Pick a Gen2 / Trusted Launch capable, x64 SKU. ARM64, -gen1, and confidential-VM (cvm) SKUs are excluded.

constraints.allowedValues: [map(filter(steps('sourceImage').skusApi, (item) => and(not(contains(toLower(item.name), 'gen1')), and(not(contains(toLower(item.name), 'arm')), not(contains(toLower(item.name), 'cvm'))))), (item) => parse(concat('{"label":"', item.name, '","value":"', item.name, '"}')))]

elements.name: sourceImageVersion
elements.label: Version
elements.toolTip: Source image version for the selected SKU (pulled live from Azure). Pick a concrete version to pin the build.

elements.name: imageDefinitionName
elements.label: Image definition name
elements.toolTip: Name for the gallery image definition created for this build. Pass the same value to Step 2. Rename to match your distro/version (e.g. CrowdStrike-RHEL-9).

validations.message: Enter an image definition name (no spaces).
